sentences.en: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝被你像对待奴隶一样对待。

sentences.en: These happy slaves are the most furious enemies of freedom.
sentences.zh: 这些快乐的奴隶是自由最愤怒的敌人。

sentences.en: The section chief made me work like a slave.
sentences.zh: 部门主管让我像奴隶一样工作。

senses.zh: 奴隶，苦工，完全受控制的人，劳工，从动装置
对另一种装置作出直接回应
